category_description: Superannuation and the Age Pension in Australia.
subcategory_description: The Age Pension, and how much it pays.
label: Age Pension maximum rate, single person (per fortnight)
context: The most a single person can get before tax, including the Pension Supplement and Energy Supplement. Income and assets can reduce it. The rates are adjusted every 20 March and 20 September.

category_description: Superannuation and the Age Pension in Australia.
subcategory_description: The Age Pension, and how much it pays.
label: Age Pension maximum rate, each member of a couple (per fortnight)
context: The most each member of a couple living together can get before tax, including the supplements.

category_description: Superannuation and the Age Pension in Australia.
subcategory_description: The Age Pension, and how much it pays.
label: Age Pension maximum rate, couple combined (per fortnight)
context: The most a couple can get together before tax, including the supplements. It is twice the rate for each member of the couple.

category_description: Superannuation and the Age Pension in Australia.

label: Age Pension age
context: The age from which most people can claim the Age Pension, if they meet the other rules.
